cards.name: Sprigatito
cards.description: Its fluffy fur is similar in composition to plants. This Pokémon frequently washes its face to keep it from drying out.

cards.name: Fuecoco
cards.description: It lies on warm rocks and uses the heat absorbed by its square-shaped scales to create fire energy.

cards.name: Quaxly
cards.description: This Pokémon migrated to Paldea from distant lands long ago. The gel secreted by its feathers repels water and grime.

cards.name: Quaquaval
cards.description: A single kick from a Quaquaval can send a truck rolling. This Pokémon uses its powerful legs to perform striking dances from far-off lands.

cards.name: Pawmot
cards.description: Pawmot's fluffy fur acts as a battery. It can store the same amount of electricity as an electric car.

cards.name: Hawlucha
cards.description: Its elegant finishing moves—performed by nimbly leaping around using its wings—are polished in the forest where it was born and raised.

cards.name: Revavroom
cards.description: It creates a gas out of poison and minerals from rocks. It then detonates the gas in its cylinders— now numbering eight—to generate energy.

cards.name: Spidops
cards.description: It clings to branches and ceilings using its threads and moves without a sound. It takes out its prey before the prey even notices it.

cards.name: Espathra
cards.description: It immobilizes opponents by bathing them in psychic power from its large eyes. Despite its appearance, it has a vicious temperament.

cards.name: Arcanine
cards.description: An ancient picture scroll shows that people were captivated by its movement as it ran through prairies.

cards.name: Dondozo
cards.description: This Pokémon is a glutton, but it's bad at getting food. It teams up with a Tatsugiri to catch prey.

cards.name: Miraidon
cards.description: Much remains unknown about this creature. It resembles Cyclizar, but it is far more ruthless and powerful.

cards.name: Koraidon
cards.description: This seems to be the Winged King mentioned in an old expedition journal. It was said to have split the land with its bare fists.

cards.name: Flaaffy
cards.description: As a result of storing too much electricity, it developed patches where even downy wool won't grow.

cards.name: Baxcalibur
cards.description: This Pokémon blasts cryogenic air out from its mouth. This air can instantly freeze even liquid-hot lava.

cards.name: Tinkaton
cards.description: This intelligent Pokémon has a very daring disposition. It knocks rocks into the sky with its hammer, aiming for flying Corviknight.

cards.name: Murkrow
cards.description: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.

cards.name: Pelipper
cards.description: It is a flying transporter that carries small Pokémon in its beak. It bobs on the waves to rest its wings.

cards.name: Smoliv
cards.description: It protects itself from enemies by emitting oil from the fruit on its head. This oil is bitter and astringent enough to make someone flinch.

cards.name: Growlithe
cards.description: It's very friendly and faithful to people. It will try to repel enemies by barking and biting.

cards.name: Tinkatink
cards.description: It swings its handmade hammer around to protect itself, but the hammer is often stolen by Pokémon that eat metal.

cards.name: Varoom
cards.description: It is said that this Pokémon was born when an unknown poison Pokémon entered and inspirited an engine left at a scrap-processing factory.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.description: Pikachu seems excited to be going on an adventure, and so do its new pals, from attention-seeking Sprigatito to laid-back Fuecoco and tidy Quaxly.

cards.name: Palafin
cards.description: This Pokémon's ancient genes have awakened. It is now so extraordinarily strong that it can easily lift a cruise ship with one fin.

cards.name: Cleffa
cards.description: Because of its unusual, starlike silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

cards.name: Togekiss
cards.description: Known as a bringer of blessings, it's been depicted on good-luck charms since ancient times.

cards.name: Mawile
cards.description: It chomps with its gaping mouth. Its huge jaws are actually steel horns that have been transformed.

cards.name: Pawmi
cards.description: It has underdeveloped electric sacs on its cheeks. These sacs can produce electricity only if Pawmi rubs them furiously with the pads on its forepaws.

cards.name: Paldean Wooper
cards.description: After losing a territorial struggle, Wooper began living on land. The Pokémon changed over time, developing a poisonous film to protect its body.

cards.name: Houndstone
cards.description: Houndstone spends most of its time sleeping in graveyards. Among all the dog Pokémon, this one is most loyal to its master.

cards.name: Eevee
cards.description: Its ability to evolve into many forms allows it to adapt smoothly and perfectly to any environment.

cards.name: Charmander
cards.description: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

cards.name: Bulbasaur
cards.description: While it is young, it uses the nutrients that are stored in the seed on its back in order to grow.

cards.name: Charmander
cards.description: From the time it is born, a flame burns at the tip of its tail. Its life would end if the flame were to go out.

cards.name: Squirtle
cards.description: When it feels threatened, it draws its limbs inside its shell and sprays water from its mouth.

cards.name: Snorlax
cards.description: This POKéMON's stomach is so strong, even eating moldy or rotten food will not affect it.

cards.name: Mewtwo
cards.description: A Pokémon created by recombining Mew's genes. It's said to have the most savage heart among Pokémon.

cards.name: Chi-Yu
cards.description: It controls flames burning at over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit. It casually swims through the sea of lava it creates by melting rock and sand.

cards.name: Iron Bundle
cards.description: It resembles a mysterious object mentioned in an old book. There are only two reported sightings of this Pokémon.

cards.name: Xatu
cards.description: This odd Pokémon can see both the past and the future. It eyes the sun's movement all day.

cards.name: Aegislash
cards.description: Its potent spectral powers allow it to manipulate others. It once used its powers to force people and Pokémon to build a kingdom to its liking.

cards.name: Pineco
cards.description: It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers of tree bark. The additional weight doesn't bother it.

cards.name: Sinistea
cards.description: The soul of someone who died alone possessed some leftover tea. This Pokémon appears in hotels and houses.

cards.name: Cetitan
cards.description: This Pokémon wanders around snowy, icy areas. It protects its body with powerful muscles and a thick layer of fat under its skin.

cards.name: Arctibax
cards.description: Arctibax freezes the air around it, protecting its face with an ice mask and turning its dorsal fin into a blade of ice.

cards.name: Scream Tail
cards.description: There has been only one reported sighting of this Pokémon. It resembles a mysterious creature depicted in an old expedition journal.

cards.name: Iron Bundle
cards.description: It resembles a mysterious object mentioned in an old book. There are only two reported sightings of this Pokémon.

cards.name: Sprigatito
cards.description: Its fluffy fur is similar in composition to plants. This Pokémon frequently washes its face to keep it from drying out.

cards.name: Floragato
cards.description: Floragato deftly wields the vine hidden beneath its long fur, slamming the hard flower bud against its opponents.

cards.name: Fuecoco
cards.description: It lies on warm rocks and uses the heat absorbed by its square-shaped scales to create fire energy.

cards.name: Crocalor
cards.description: The combination of Crocalor's fire energy and overflowing vitality has caused an egg-shaped fireball to appear on the Pokémon's head.

cards.name: Quaxly
cards.description: This Pokémon migrated to Paldea from distant lands long ago. The gel secreted by its feathers repels water and grime.

cards.name: Quaxwell
cards.description: These Pokémon constantly run through shallow waters to train their legs, then compete with each other to see which of them kicks most gracefully.

cards.name: Pikachu with Grey Felt Hat
cards.description: When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches of its cheeks.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.description: When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

cards.name: Feraligatr
cards.description: It usually moves slowly, but it goes at blinding speed when it attacks and bites prey.

cards.name: Metang
cards.description: Two Beldum have become stuck together via their own magnetic forces. With two brains, the resulting Metang has doubled psychic powers.

cards.name: Koraidon
cards.description: This seems to be the Winged King mentioned in an old expedition journal. It was said to have split the land with its bare fists.

cards.name: Miraidon
cards.description: This seems to be the Iron Serpent mentioned in an old book. The Iron Serpent is said to have turned the land to ash with its lightning.

cards.name: Carvanha
cards.description: These Pokémon have sharp fangs and powerful jaws. Sailors avoid Carvanha dens at all costs.

cards.name: Bellibolt
cards.description: When this Pokémon expands and contracts its wobbly body, the belly-button dynamo in its stomach produces a huge amount of electricity.

cards.name: Cleffa
cards.description: Because of its unusual, starlike silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

cards.name: Cyclizar
cards.description: Apparently Cyclizar has been allowing people to ride on its back since ancient times. Depictions of this have been found in 10,000-year-old murals.

cards.name: Flutter Mane
cards.description: This Pokémon has characteristics similar to those of Flutter Mane, a creature mentioned in a certain book.

cards.name: Iron Thorns
cards.description: Some of its notable features match those of an object named within a certain expedition journal as Iron Thorns.

cards.name: Shroodle
cards.description: Though usually a mellow Pokémon, it will sink its sharp, poison-soaked front teeth into any that anger it, causing paralysis in the object of its ire.

cards.name: Pikachu
cards.description: When it is angered, it immediately discharges the energy stored in the pouches in its cheeks.

cards.name: Oddish
cards.description: During the day, it stays in the cold underground to avoid the sun. It grows by bathing in moonlight.

cards.name: Thwackey
cards.description: The faster a Thwackey can beat out a rhythm with its two sticks, the more respect it wins from its peers.

cards.name: Infernape
cards.description: Its crown of fire is indicative of its fiery nature. It is beaten by none in terms of quickness.

cards.name: Froslass
cards.description: It freezes prey by blowing its −58 degree Fahrenheit breath. It is said to then secretly display its prey.

cards.name: Tatsugiri
cards.description: Tatsugiri is an extremely cunning Pokémon. It feigns weakness to lure in prey, then orders its partner to attack.

cards.name: Toxel
cards.description: It has no problem drinking dirty water. An organ inside Toxel's body filters such water into a poisonous liquid that is harmless to Toxel.

cards.name: Pupitar
cards.description: This pupa flies around wildly by venting with great force the gas pressurized inside its body.

cards.name: Revavroom
cards.description: It creates a gas out of poison and minerals from rocks. It then detonates the gas in its cylinders— now numbering eight—to generate energy.

cards.name: Snorlax
cards.description: It is not satisfied unless it eats over 880 pounds of food every day. When it is done eating, it goes promptly to sleep.

cards.name: Teal Mask Ogerpon
cards.description: This mischief-loving Pokémon is full of curiosity. It battles by drawing out the type-based energy contained within its masks.

cards.name: Pecharunt
cards.description: Its peach-shaped shell serves as storage for a potent poison. It makes poisonous mochi and serves them to people and Pokémon.

cards.name: Kingambit
cards.description: Only a Bisharp that stands above all others in its vast army can evolve into Kingambit.

cards.name: Ledian
cards.description: When the stars flicker in the night sky, it flutters about, scattering a glowing powder.

cards.name: Crabominable
cards.description: Though its punches are powerful, this Pokémon's movements are sluggish. It blows icy bubbles from its mouth to immobilize its opponents.

cards.name: Drifblim
cards.description: They carry people and Pokémon, but the wind can catch them, so there can't be a fixed destination.

cards.name: Bouffalant
cards.description: These Pokémon can crush a car with no more than a headbutt. Bouffalant with more hair on their heads hold higher positions within the herd.

cards.name: Horsea
cards.description: They swim with dance-like motions and cause whirlpools to form. Horsea compete to see which of them can generate the biggest whirlpool.

cards.name: Porygon2
cards.description: After artificial intelligence was implemented in Porygon2, the Pokémon began using a strange language that only other Porygon2 understand.

cards.name: Latias
cards.description: It can telepathically communicate with people. It changes its appearance using its down that refracts light.

cards.name: Tinkaton
cards.description: This intelligent Pokémon has a very daring disposition. It knocks rocks into the sky with its hammer, aiming for flying Corviknight.

cards.name: Noctowl
cards.description: Its extremely soft wings make no sound in flight. It silently sneaks up on prey without being detected.

cards.name: Pecharunt
cards.description: Its peach-shaped shell serves as storage for a potent poison. It makes poisonous mochi and serves them to people and Pokémon.
